newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse to change blue-chip A firm list.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse to change blue-chip A firm list.

text.p: The Shanghai Stock Exchange will change the list of companies on a blue-chip index for A shares, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.
About three of the original 30 companies on the index are expected to be replaced, with the new list to take effect on October 1, it said but gave no details.
Shanghai brokers said they expected Jinan Qinqi Motorcycles Co and Hangzhou Jiefang Road Department Store Co to become part of the index.
The exchange launched the blue-chip index on July 1 with the aim of more effectively reflecting market trends.
Companies on the index are selected on the basis of their market capitalisation, number of listed shares and performance in the past few years.
The exchange has said it will modify the list from time to time to make the index more liquid and reflect changes in companies and the market, with changes every three months.
